capabilities: fetch daily coding stats from WakaTime
insert stats at the top of daily notes
refresh existing stats instead of duplicating them
trigger manual refresh from the command palette
extras: Requires a WakaTime account and API access; README does not cover setup steps or error handling.
problem: Obsidian daily notes have no way to show your coding activity from WakaTime without manual copying.

relations.evidence: Show your WakaTime stats in your Obsidian daily notes.

summary: WakaTime integration that fetches daily coding-time stats and inserts or refreshes them inside your daily notes.
